newsitem.title: USA: Laboratory Corp secures $187 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Laboratory Corp secures $187 mln loan.

text.p: Laboratory Corp of America Holdings on Monday said it obtained a $187 million loan from an affiliate of Roche Holding Ltd, which controls the company's principal stockholder.

The company said it would use proceeds to pay a previously announced settlement with the U.S. government to conclude investigations into the billing practices of companies that merged to form Laboratory Corp in 1995.

The loan was an interim step in Laboratory's plan to recapitalize. Still, the company said it believed it would need to raise additional equity and there was no assurance it would be able to carry out the recapitalization plan successfully.
Laboratory Corp also said it obtained an extension to January 31 of an existing waiver of certain covenant in its bank credit agreement.
